requirement: Ingest historical OHLCTV bars for configured instruments/timeframes
acceptance_criteria: Backfill completes; schema validates; missing intervals flagged; lineage stored

requirement: Ingest real-time trades, quotes, and order-book data where available
acceptance_criteria: Stream freshness, sequence gaps, duplicates, and reconnects measured and alerted

requirement: Normalize symbols, assets, venues, tick size, lot size, min notional, fees
acceptance_criteria: Canonical instrument maps to venue-specific identifiers and constraints

requirement: Compute TA features with point-in-time correctness
acceptance_criteria: Leakage tests pass; higher timeframe features lagged until close

requirement: Compute basic liquidity/cost features
acceptance_criteria: Spread, volume, volatility, and fee features available at decision time

requirement: Build chronological train/validation/test snapshots
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot hash, split rules, labels, and feature versions stored

requirement: Train baselines before transformer candidates
acceptance_criteria: Baseline report includes cash, buy-and-hold, TA heuristic, simple ML

requirement: Produce probabilistic outputs and uncertainty
acceptance_criteria: Forecast object includes probabilities/quantiles, calibration status, and uncertainty

requirement: Support trade/no-trade decisions
acceptance_criteria: Decision object includes expected return, expected cost, net edge, uncertainty, and reason code

requirement: Enforce independent pre-trade controls
acceptance_criteria: Forced-breach tests block unsafe orders 100% of the time

requirement: Provide manual and automated kill switches
acceptance_criteria: Kill state persists across restart and blocks new orders

requirement: Run historical replay with costs and slippage
acceptance_criteria: Backtest includes fees, spread, slippage, latency, partial/failed fills

requirement: Run paper strategy on live data
acceptance_criteria: Paper account logs signals, orders, fills, portfolio, TCA, and rejections

requirement: Evaluate model, strategy, portfolio, and engine separately
acceptance_criteria: Reports include model calibration, net strategy metrics, portfolio risk, TCA

requirement: Reconstruct decisions from trace ID
acceptance_criteria: Sampled decisions replay data, features, model output, checks, and order intent

requirement: Support multiple exchange/broker adapters
acceptance_criteria: Two adapters pass shared capability and order lifecycle tests

requirement: Allocate capital across assets/strategies under constraints
acceptance_criteria: Allocator respects exposure, volatility, correlation, venue, and cash constraints

requirement: Use offline RL/bandits for sizing or strategy selection
acceptance_criteria: Policy beats deterministic heuristic in validation without worse drawdown/CVaR

requirement: Support champion/challenger and shadow mode
acceptance_criteria: Candidate scores live data without influencing orders until approved

requirement: Calibrate slippage/fill models from paper/live fills
acceptance_criteria: TCA compares arrival mid, realized fill, predicted slippage, and benchmark prices

requirement: Add exogenous feature families
acceptance_criteria: New source passes license, leakage, quality, and incremental-value gates

requirement: Support funding, borrow, margin, expiry, liquidation
acceptance_criteria: Derivative strategies blocked until all derivative-specific fields and risk controls exist

requirement: Prevent lookahead leakage
acceptance_criteria: Automated leakage tests fail build on future-derived features or labels

requirement: Protect API keys and secrets
acceptance_criteria: Secrets manager; no secret in logs/code; least-privilege and withdrawal-disabled keys where possible

requirement: Recover ingestion from disconnects
acceptance_criteria: Reconnect and gap-fill test passes without duplicate data

requirement: Log all live decisions and overrides
acceptance_criteria: Orders cannot be submitted without traceable decision and risk approval

requirement: Re-run experiments from run ID
acceptance_criteria: Metrics reproduce within tolerance from stored data/config/code/model

requirement: Fail closed on stale critical feeds
acceptance_criteria: Risk engine blocks affected strategy/instrument if required feed stale

requirement: Onboard new venues without core changes
acceptance_criteria: Adapter contract tests pass; core strategy/model code unchanged

requirement: Track infrastructure and data costs
acceptance_criteria: Cost report available per experiment and production day
